market.what: PFAS removal media and systems for drinking water (GAC, IX, new sorbents), world
market.method: reports put PFAS treatment at $2.1-2.8B (2025); GAC+IX ~70% -> ~$1.6B; cross-check: US O&M at full compliance $0.76-1.01B/yr (AWWA/B&V) + EU EUR3.6B/10 yr

value.logic: media O&M: US $0.76-1.01B/yr + EU ~$0.4B/yr = ~$1.2B/yr; sorbent with ~3x GAC bed life cuts change-outs ~40% -> ~$0.5B/yr (smaller vessels also trim $37-48B US capex; not counted)
value.revenue_logic: ~1.5% of ~$2.4B media market by yr 7, sold through a water-treatment major (Kurita/Cyclopure-style deal)
value.margin_logic: specialty sorbent priced well above GAC (~$3-5/kg), toll-made; partner takes distribution cut

trend.drivers: EPA 4 ppt PFOA/PFOS; EU DWD 0.1 ug/L sum-20 from Jan 2026; utility buildout (AWK ~$1B, WTRG ~$450M)

competition.notes: groups capped at 200 by per-page=200 (true count higher). GAC/IX already meet 4 ppt for long-chain, so the bar is cost per m3. Puraffinity $25.8M raised, NSF 61 for G400+ (2026); Cyclopure ~$10M + Kurita stake and US exclusive (2025-26); Claros $55M Series B; Oxyle $16M seed

lab.synth: macrocycle/polymer/resin: active site must be fixed on a bead or polymer to be usable in a column
lab.test: batch isotherms + rapid small-scale column test (RSSCT, ASTM D6586) on spiked tap water; PFAS by EPA 533/537.1 (e.g. MSU Center for PFAS Research)
lab.logic: 12-14 wk resin synth with 3 variants ($30k) + 4-5 wk tests; ~40 EPA 533 samples x $241 = ~$10k + RSSCT/isotherm labor ~$15k

sale.gates: NSF/ANSI 61 (lab test 2-3 wk, full listing ~6-12 mo est.); utility pilot vs GAC 6-12 mo; state approval
